method.scan: Every saved Overworld chunk inside the displayed map extent
method.markerUnit: One verified 16x16x16 section, not one entire geological vein. A vein can contain multiple markers; on-screen clusters are only a display grouping.
method.detection: Section contains at least 80 iron ore, 16 uncolored terracotta, 8 tuff and 8 distinct iron blocks directly touching uncolored terracotta on a face within the section.
method.limits: All sections meeting this rule are marked. Small, heavily mined, or isolated remnants below these cutoffs may not be included. The full iron density layer still includes ordinary iron.
